# Welcome to [Physics Voyage]{.smallcaps}

I'm a [physicist]{.underline} in training, documenting the voyage through quantum mechanics, many-body theory, and the code that makes the cosmos computable.

This site is my open notebook — structured courses, project write-ups, and a blog that goes deeper than the textbook. No hand-waving. Everything built from first principles, mistakes included.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  async function fetchYouTubeData() {
    try {
      // Fetch the statically generated JSON file using relative path to support subpath hosting
      const response = await fetch("youtube-data.json");
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not load youtube-data.json");
      }
      const data = await response.json();
      
      // Latest Video
      document.getElementById("youtube-latest-iframe").src = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${data.latest.id}`;
      const latestLink = document.getElementById("youtube-latest-title");
      latestLink.href = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${data.latest.id}`;
      latestLink.textContent = data.latest.title;

      // Popular Video
      document.getElementById("youtube-popular-iframe").src = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${data.popular.id}`;
      const popularLink = document.getElementById("youtube-popular-title");
      popularLink.href = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${data.popular.id}`;
      popularLink.textContent = data.popular.title;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching YouTube data:", error);
      document.getElementById("youtube-latest-title").textContent = "Video unavailable";
      document.getElementById("youtube-popular-title").textContent = "Video unavailable";
    }
  }

  fetchYouTubeData();
});
</script>
